generator_source.implementation: Independently authored Python standard-library generator; upstream programs were not executed.

inspiration.ideas: Zipf, scrambled key ranks, hotspot and latest-style locality concepts.
Independent adaptation of configurable distribution and Bernoulli mixture ideas.

generator_source.mapping: Official fixed mapping pid = key % P; keys are never hashed by the simulator.
generator_source.size_models: Bernoulli mixture, lognormal and gamma are independent local implementations. Tuple draws are clipped to [1024, 1048576]; final residuals may be smaller.

distribution: Direct Zipf exponent 1.8 sampling of partition ranks, with varying keys per partition. Partition byte budgets use lognormal sigma=1.6 weights, with an amplified maximum and suppressed minimum per operator; all partitions are positive and capped at M.
